name: PTB-XL: Large Publicly Available 12-Lead ECG Dataset
description: PTB-XL is a clinical dataset of 21,837 12-lead electrocardiograms (ECGs) of 10-second duration recorded from 18,885 patients. The dataset features comprehensive clinical annotations conforming to SCP-ECG standards covering diagnostic statements (normality, myocardial infarction, conduction disturbances), rhythm statements, and form statements.
